highlights.title: A more capable config editor
highlights.description: Find configs outside ModConfigs, search by folder, review changes before saving, undo the last save, and recover from conflicting disk edits.

highlights.title: Mod profiles with their settings
highlights.description: Optionally save selected config files with a mod profile and restore them during a reviewed restart.

highlights.title: Support reports you can review
highlights.description: Preview versions, enabled mods, and recent errors with sensitive values removed before copying the report into a bug report.

highlights.title: Help is easier to find
highlights.description: Open the wiki, report an issue, or request a feature directly from the dashboard.
